title.zh: 在萨马省Borongan市镇设立国立区域农业学校，名称为东萨马国立区域农业学校的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a National Regional Agricultural School in the Municipality of Borongan, Province of Samar, to be Known as the Eastern Samar, National Regional Agricultural School
title.orig: An Act to Establish a National Regional Agricultural School in the Municipality of Borongan, Province of Samar, to be Known as the Eastern Samar, National Regional Agricultural School
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Nông nghiệp Quốc gia Vùng tại Thị trấn Borongan, Tỉnh Samar với tên gọi Trường Nông nghiệp Eastern Samar Quốc gia Vùng
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนเกษตรกรรมแห่งชาติภูมิภาคในเทศบาล Borongan จังหวัด Samar ในชื่อโรงเรียนเกษตรกรรม Eastern Samar แห่งชาติภูมิภาค
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Pertanian Nasional Regional di Kotamadya Borongan, Provinsi Samar dengan nama Sekolah Pertanian Eastern Samar Nasional Regional
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Pertanian Kebangsaan Wilayah di Perbandaran Borongan, Wilayah Samar dengan nama Sekolah Pertanian Eastern Samar Kebangsaan Wilayah

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2434_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Public Schools, a national regional agricultural school of the Negros Occidental National Agricultural School type in the Municipality of Borongan, Province of Samar, at a suitable site to be selected by said Director, to be known as the Eastern Samar National Regional Agricultural School.

Upon the recommendation of the Director of Public Schools, the President shall set aside and reserve such portion of the public lands located within the Municipality of Borongan of said province, as may be necessary and convenient for the establishment of the said school and its farm site.

The sum of three hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the said school during the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred sixty. Such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

Thi s Act shall take effect upon the date the funds authorized herein to be appropriated shall have been provided for.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
